scripts.example:simple:libuv: pnpm run libuv:bootstrap && cmake -S examples/simple -B dist/examples/simple/build-libuv -DINOX_LOOP_BACKEND=libuv && cmake --build dist/examples/simple/build-libuv && ./dist/examples/simple/build-libuv/inox_cmake_example
scripts.example:simple:libuv-boringssl: pnpm run libuv:bootstrap && pnpm run boringssl:bootstrap && cmake -S examples/simple -B dist/examples/simple/build-libuv-boringssl -DINOX_LOOP_BACKEND=libuv -DINOX_TLS_BACKEND=boringssl && cmake --build dist/examples/simple/build-libuv-boringssl && ./dist/examples/simple/build-libuv-boringssl/inox_cmake_example
scripts.example:http-server: pnpm run libuv:bootstrap && cmake -S examples/http-server -B dist/examples/http-server/build && cmake --build dist/examples/http-server/build && ./dist/examples/http-server/build/inox_http_server_example
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:features
